objective: Audit GitHub-primary read-only APIs for observing repository self-hosted runner registration, status, busy state, labels and groups before owner-host inspection, and determine whether they can cheaply distinguish WP1207 runner-assignment hypotheses without dispatching or mutating the runtime subject.
result: GitHub-primary remote runner roster/group APIs can expose status/busy/labels/eligibility, but the installed connector does not expose the actions/runners endpoint. Unsupported/denied observation must remain RUNNER_STATUS_UNKNOWN, never OFFLINE.
